content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the HPU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of HPU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HPU Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the HPU Assistant Professor recruitment is 07 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 26 vacancies announced for the Assistant Professor positions across various departments at Himachal Pradesh University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 2000/-. SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 1000/-, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 57,700 to Rs. 1,82,400 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications are as per UGC Regulations, 2018, and AICTE norms 2019 for the UIT department.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for HPU Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a screening of applications followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Himachal Pradesh apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from all over India are eligible to apply, provided they meet the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official HPU Assistant Professor recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article or from the official HPU website.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation for reserved categories will be provided as per the rules and regulations of the Himachal Pradesh government and UGC.

faq.question: Q10. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications for the HPU Assistant Professor positions must be submitted online through the official website or the provided application link.
